descriptionChirho: A proper noun referring to Zibeon, a Horite/Hivite clan chief and ancestor figure in the genealogies of Esau and Seir (Gen 36:2,14,20,24,29; 1 Chr 1:38,40). All three clusters are syntactic variants of the same personal name: bare and prepositional forms 'Zibeon/Tsivon/for Zibeon' (S129453), conjunctive forms 'and Tsiv'on/Tsibon' (S129454), and a further conjunctive occurrence 'and Zibeon' (S129457). Multilingual evidence uniformly points to a single referent: 'सिब्योन/सिबोन' (hin), 'صِبْعُونَ/صِبْعون' (arb), '시비온/시브온' (kor), 'Zibioni/Sibeoni' (swa), 'Tsivon/Tsibon' (spa). No semantic distinction exists between these purely grammatical variants.
